authorization.rule: Later stages may be implemented and tested in isolation, but no stage may be marked EARNED until all inherited prerequisite gates and its own gate pass with evidence.

stage_sequence.name: Identity and onboarding
stage_sequence.gate: A new customer registers, enters AXIOM, creates a project, and runs an entitled safe task without manual database provisioning.

stage_sequence.name: Cloud Project and Work Graph
stage_sequence.gate: The same project opens correctly on two devices without provenance loss or cross-tenant exposure.

stage_sequence.name: Durable execution kernel
stage_sequence.gate: A task survives browser closure, Worker restart, injected timeout, and transient tool failure without duplicate side effects.

stage_sequence.name: Ordered full tool-fabric connection
stage_sequence.gate: Every registered tool executes successfully through the same production-shaped orchestrator; no UI uses separate local simulation.

stage_sequence.name: Unified application
stage_sequence.gate: Five unfamiliar users complete priority tasks without developer assistance.

stage_sequence.name: Adversarial qualification
stage_sequence.gate: Zero open critical/high findings; every consequential action requires exact authorization; independent verifier reproduces the verdict.

stage_sequence.name: Reliability and scale qualification
stage_sequence.gate: All release targets hold under the defined reliability/scale test matrix with retained failures and reproducible evidence.

stage_sequence.name: Sealed frontier benchmarks
stage_sequence.rule: Seal benchmark tasks/scoring before implementation tuning; no sealed benchmark may be used for tuning afterward.
baselines: strong finance/quant systems plus human experts
stage_sequence.gate: Use unseen/equivalent tasks, predefined scoring, retained failures, independent reproduction, statistically significant AXIOM win on authorized comparison claims, no worse safety/authorization, and disclosed cost/latency. No superiority/parity claim is authorized without this evidence.

stage_sequence.name: Staged production rollout
stage_sequence.gate: Production release may proceed only after the full sequence passes at the exact candidate head with rollback proof and explicit human production approval.

inherited_release_law: AR-02 remains incomplete until its external GitLab/provider/security gates are actually earned.
AR-03 through AR-11 may be implemented in isolation but remain NOT_EARNED while an inherited prerequisite is incomplete.
No later-stage implementation may weaken AR-02 security or rewrite missing evidence as PASS.
No production deployment, secret rotation, repository authority transition, or public comparative claim is authorized by this contract.
